description: 荒川区: GTFS transit data is a dataset listed in Mobility Database, a catalogue of GTFS and GTFS Realtime transit feeds, published or maintained by 荒川区. Public transport schedule data (routes, stops, trips and stop times in the General Transit Feed Specification) for Arakawa, Tokyo, Japan. Coverage: Arakawa, Tokyo, Japan. The Mobility Database lists 1 GTFS schedule feed for this provider (Arakawa, Tokyo, Japan). The schedule feeds declare these GTFS features: Fares V1, Feed Information, Headsigns, Location Types, Shapes, Translations. At least one feed is marked as published by the operator itself. Note in the listing: 荒川区コミュニティバス「さくら」 It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, accessibility and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-mobility-database-mobilitydata.
